title: Windows ssh-keygen loading an unsigned PKCS#11 provider DLL

searches.name: Windows SSH Keygen Unsigned PKCS11 Provider Load
searches.spl:
`sysmon` EventCode IN (1,7) process_name="ssh-keygen.exe"
    | eval process_command_line=if(EventCode=1,process,null())
    | eventstats values(process_command_line) AS process_command_line by dest process_guid
    | where EventCode=7 AND NOT match(ImageLoaded,"(?i)^[a-z]:\\\\(windows|program files[^\\\\]*)\\\\") AND (lower(Signed)="false" OR coalesce(SignatureStatus,"")!="Valid")
    | stats count min(_time) AS firstTime max(_time) AS lastTime values(process_command_line) AS process values(process_id) AS process_id values(process_name) AS process_name values(user) AS user values(Signed) AS Signed values(SignatureStatus) AS SignatureStatus by dest process_guid Image ImageLoaded
    | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
    | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
    | `windows_ssh_keygen_unsigned_pkcs11_provider_load_filter`
